text:
Olivia: heads-up — seeing intermittent token duplication + a one-token shift when resuming generation from a checkpoint with the new int4 model on staging. Repro ~1/30 runs.
Sam: which model/version + quant config?
Olivia: model id oqv2-13b-int4 (new onboarding). Happens after long runs (>32k tokens) when we checkpoint and then restore+continue.
Devan: I ran a quick repro. Logs: 
``
seq=32768 batch=1 resume=true kv_offset=32768 -> emitted duplicate token at pos 32769
log: kv_read[idx=8128]=... != kv_write_expected
```
Repro steps I used: generate to ~32k, checkpoint, restore, continue generation.
Marta: hypothesis: the issue looks like a rotary scaling/index drift after a sharded KV memcpy on restore. int4_grouped packing + alignment can cause off-by-one index if a memcpy boundary isn't page-aligned.
Sam: can you paste the exact quant config and runtime flags you used? scheduler, group_size, page_align, prefetch?
Devan: config snippet: 
``
quant: int4_grouped
group_size: 128
page_align: true
kv_prefetch: true
rotary_scale: dynamic
resume_check: none
```
Olivia: important: when I disable kv_prefetch the failure rate goes to ~0/100 runs. With prefetch=true it's flaky (~3%).
Marta: that strongly implicates the prefetch path + alignment. Maybe prefetched buffers are being concatenated with different alignment assumptions on restore. Suggest adding an assert after restore: check that kvcache.write_pos == expected_pos and that per-shard offsets sum to total.
Devan: added quick assert to restore hook and reran 50 cycles: 49/50 passed, 1 failed. Pasted failure snippet above.
ci-bot: test job reproduce-int4-kv-fuzz (4821) finished: status flaky (pass 92%, fail 8%). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/4821/logs
Sam: mitigation idea: for resume path, force rotary_scale=static and kv_prefetch=false as a temporary fallback on dedicated/staging nodes until we root cause. Lower blast radius.
Olivia: sounds good. I'll file a bug and schedule a canary rollback/fallback. Assigning to @Devan to triage and add instrumentation. :thumbsup:
Devan: will instrument memalign checks, add checksums for per-shard kv blocks on write/restore, and create a repro harness that varies group_size (64/128/256), page_align true/false, and with/without prefetch. Kicking off runs on dedicated-qa (a100-40).
Marta: also add a deterministic unit test: generate 0..34k tokens without checkpoint vs checkpoint-restore-continue and assert token-by-token equality. Should catch the drift quickly.
Olivia: filing bug BUG-1972 with the initial findings + CI artifacts. Also drafting a short customer-facing note in case we see any customer-facing regressions leak.
Sam: ping if you need extra GPU cycles. If the harness reproduces reliably, we can try disabling grouped int4 (fall back to per-tensor int8) for resume builds.
Devan: starting runs now, will post artifacts and a short triage log when done.
ci-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/ci-4821/repro.tar.gz
Olivia: next steps summary: (1) short fallback in resume path this week (kv_prefetch=false + rotary_scale=static), (2) full root-cause triage with memalign/checksum instrumentation (assign Devan + Marta), (3) add deterministic unit/regression tests to prevent future regressions, (4) update onboarding checklist to include resume/restore fuzzing for quantized models. I'll update this thread as things progress.
